title: Zone A escalates from evacuation to rescue
description: New field information about INC-001 (more people, injuries) and a full road closure push it up the priority scale.

steps.note: Field team reports more residents and two injured people.
Access factor rises to the maximum.

expected: INC-001 is reassessed after each step; threat factor rises (injured -> 22) and people factor rises (65 -> 20)
A severity_increase alert is raised when the level goes up
Previously approved ground-vehicle actions for Zone A are flagged for reassessment after the closure
